note: City of Dayton campground at Oak Park, beside the golf course and the rodeo grounds, with shelters and a playground. The city publishes no site count, rate or hookup detail; ask City Hall or the clubhouse. --Claude
summary: The city's one-paragraph recreation page confirms a campground with hookups and a shower house, and says to contact City Hall or the clubhouse; it gives no rate, site count, hookup type, season or reservation rule. Showers confirmed; nothing else to write; not waterfront stands.
flags: NO RATE: no operator source publishes a nightly rate, site count or hookup type. Only aggregators speak (parkadvisor: 44 full-hookup sites, 40-ft max, April-October; a Roadtrippers $75 figure attached to a 228-site listing is plainly another place). Nothing was written from them. Unresearched by phone.

BOOKING: stored reservable:true / platform:phone (derived from the old note) is not stated by the city page, which only says 'CONTACT CITY HALL OR THE CLUB HOUSE (DURING THE SEASON) FOR INFORMATION' (its 'reservation information' wording is about the clubhouse rental). Left as stored, since the page does not contradict it; the redundant 'Reserve through City Hall' was cut from the note.

PHONE: stored 515-547-2712 is the Oak Park Golf & Recreation clubhouse (Google), which the city page names as the in-season contact. City Hall is 515-547-2711 (Iowa League of Cities directory; the city site posts no number). Either is valid; no change needed.
WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' confirmed. The only water on imagery is a small creek channel about 200 m NW of the clubhouse/rodeo area, behind the arena and a band of trees.

PIN: stored 42.25640,-94.06900 sits at the clubhouse beside the rodeo arena. Imagery shows no RVs and no site pads I can identify with confidence; the likeliest camping area is the gravel-road grass block just S at ~42.2550,-94.0675 (about 190 m), so the pin is left alone. A weak spot.
